$description: Tier 1 · App theme: Synapse (magenta 352, live synaptic teal 195). Emitted in dist/tokens.css as `[data-theme="synapse"] { --g-theme-… }`. Raw hex only, and only these slots: a change here is a change in Figma first (scripts/figma-parity.mjs holds the two together).
